title: Nutty Gooey Argentinian Seafood Empanadas
description: Charred and gooey empanadas filled with a seafood mixture, perfect for a weeknight dinner, featuring a plant-based friendly seafood stock and spherified elements.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and a pinch of salt to make the empanada dough.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
In a separate bowl, mix the seafood stock, sodium alginate, and water to create a spherified seafood mixture.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, crumbled tofu, nutritional yeast, and smoked paprika to the bowl and mix well.
Divide the empanada dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a spoonful of the seafood mixture in the center.
Fold the empanada in half and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
